criterion.criterion_text: STABILIZED_WITHIN_WINDOW iff there exists t* <= window_s - hold_min_s such that the body rate norm stays <= rate_settle_dps for every sample in [t*, window_s]; otherwise NOT_STABILIZED_WITHIN_WINDOW. Deterministic fixed-grid evaluation with time_step_s equal to the thruster minimum pulse width so every pulse is grid-aligned.
